<MethodEndpoint
  method={"delete"}
  path={"/api/delete_project/{guid}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Permanently deletes a project: removes its directory from disk, drops
its saved node-position/order entries, unregisters it from the hub's
project registry, and removes every user's dev clone of it. Commits the
deletion to the instance repo, schedules a runtime reload in the
background, and emits a project-delete system event.
